$comment: Sidecar binary hashes. These do NOT verify upstream -- only the PGP signature in scripts/build-sidecar.sh does that. They exist so CI can detect when a rebuild drifts from what was reviewed and recorded here.

source.$comment: ffmpeg.org publishes a .asc signature, not a .sha256 file. The signature is the upstream check; this hash is recorded for reproducibility.

license.$comment: Audited at build time: scripts/build-sidecar.sh greps -buildconf for enable-gpl, enable-nonfree, libx264, libx265 and libfdk, and fails the build if any is present.

ffmpeg-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.$comment: REVIEWED BUILD. Does not include lavfi or the synthetic test sources; see the next entry for the fixture-capable build.

windows.$comment: Built by CI under MSYS2 with the same configure line. No Windows machine needed to produce a Windows package.
